title: WSGI vs ASGI, Gunicorn and Uvicorn

scenes.say: WSGI or ASGI—do you know which server your app needs?

scenes.label: WSGI
scenes.sub: Synchronous interface for Django and Flask.
scenes.say: WSGI is the classic synchronous interface used by Django and Flask.

scenes.label: ASGI
scenes.say: ASGI is the async interface, perfect for FastAPI and real-time features.
Gunicorn runs WSGI apps like Django and Flask. Uvicorn handles ASGI apps, like FastAPI.

scenes.title: How to run each
scenes.say: Use Gunicorn for Django or Flask, and Uvicorn for FastAPI in production.

scenes.question: Can you use Gunicorn for FastAPI?
scenes.right: No, FastAPI needs an ASGI server like Uvicorn.
scenes.say: Don’t mix them up! FastAPI needs an ASGI server like Uvicorn, not Gunicorn.
